tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Every text color below is checked on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles, code blocks and the terminal panel. Sits on `bg` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate full-width bands: AI demo, next-case and contact sections, and the diagram panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative separators only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of form fields and other controls. 3:1 or better on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Long-form paragraphs on `bg` and `surface`: case studies, notes, research.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels and inactive nav links on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pastel blue taken from the portrait background. Links, active nav, highlighted words, diagram highlights and the primary button fill. Text on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill, such as the primary button and the active language toggle.

tokens.name: accent-cyan
tokens.usage: Alternate accent. Swap it in for `accent` through `data-accent="cyan"`; same rules as `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-lavender
tokens.usage: Alternate accent closest to the purple in the portrait. Swap it in through `data-accent="lavender"`; same rules as `accent`.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles: home hero and case-study titles. One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles on the home page and in call-to-action bands.
styles.sample: Three projects, built end to end.

styles.name: h2-article
styles.usage: Section headings inside case studies and notes.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Project titles in the work list and next-case links.

styles.name: h4
styles.sample: Why semantic search and structured queries together

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The sentence under a page title. Set in `text-muted`.
styles.sample: A chatbot that answers questions and generates reports.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Paragraphs in case studies and research. Set in `text-body`.
styles.sample: I joined the frontend of an internal engineering-process platform.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, lists and form input.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, helper text and footnotes. Set in `text-muted`.
styles.sample: I usually reply within a few days.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, stat captions and tags. Set in `accent` or `text-muted`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Nav links, breadcrumbs, chips, dates and diagram steps.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and text links with an arrow.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: dot to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inside small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its heading; diagram box gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large card padding; gap between page title and lead.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter and gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between article sections and page columns.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Padding above and below a call-to-action band.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Padding above and below a home-page section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Padding above and below a hero or contact section.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for buttons, cards, inputs, chips and panels. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The portrait and status dots only.

layout.note: Layout widths and fixed heights used by every page.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of every page. Center it and pad each side with `container-gutter`.

tokens.name: container-gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the page container. Equal to `space-10`.

tokens.name: measure-article
tokens.usage: Maximum width of case-study body text.

tokens.name: measure-note
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a note article, including its header and author card.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the top navigation bar.
